notes: Specs sourced from Netgear's official combined GC728X/GC728XP datasheet (DS-GC728X/GC728XP-0, 2018), which lists ports for both models in one table. Only GC728XP-specific data used (PoE+ 24 ports/390W budget, 2 fans). Dimensions 440x224x44mm (17.3x8.8x1.7in) confirm 1U rackmount form factor (desktop-capable via included feet). The two "Gigabit SFP" ports and two "10G SFP+" ports are each dedicated (not combo/shared with copper ports) per the datasheet's "Dedicated" notation. USB port speed/version and exact AC inlet connector variant (C13 vs C14) are not explicitly stated in the datasheet — connector type inferred as standard USB-A and IEC power inlet based on standard practice for this switch class; confidence remains high overall since all port counts/types and grades are explicitly confirmed in the manufacturer datasheet.

ports.note: Internal fixed AC power supply, 100-240VAC 50-60Hz 10A max; AC power cord (localized to country of sale) included. Rear IEC inlet inferred from internal-PSU design and included country-specific detachable cord; exact IEC variant (C13/C14) not explicitly stated in datasheet.
